JEV_API_KEY.name: JEV_API_KEY
JEV_API_KEY.description: Optional access key. Blank = open public instance (the default). When set, every endpoint except GET /health requires 'Authorization: Bearer <JEV_API_KEY>' (header, or append ?apiKey=<value> to the URL). Set it to lock a shared instance down — clear it to open it back up. No key is needed to run: the model is self-contained and free.
